
{{alias}}( n, x )
    Evaluates the Legendre polynomial of degree n.

    Parameters
    ----------
    n: number
        Polynomial degree.

    x: number
        Point at which to evaluate the polynomial.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Evaluated Legendre polynomial.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 2, 0.5 )
    -0.125
    > v = {{alias}}( 1, 0.5 )
    0.5
    > v = {{alias}}( -1.5, 0.5 )
    ~0.795
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 0.5 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
